name: Freshsales
tagline: Freshsales is an AI-powered CRM by Freshworks that helps sales teams manage leads, automate follow-ups, and close deals faster. Its Freddy AI scores leads, predicts deal outcomes, and suggests next best actions to help reps focus on the highest-value opportunities.
